## X.Y (YYYY-MM-DD)

### Added

- **Name of the feature.** What you can do now, in one sentence.

### Changed

- What behaves differently from the previous version, and what to do if you
  preferred the old behaviour.

### Fixed

- What went wrong before, described as the user saw it.

### Removed

- What is gone, and what to use instead.

### Known issues

- What does not work yet, with a link to the issue.

### Requirements

<!-- Only if they changed. -->

- macOS 13 or later.
